criteria.support_condition: No determinate support condition for the complete statement can be set without adding a threshold for the knowledge gap and the strength of suspicion. Experimental findings can establish an evidential basis for concern without settling those qualifications.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No determinate contradiction condition follows from the wording. Some documented deployments would not refute 'in many ways', and an absence of demonstrated real-world harm would not refute a stated suspicion.
